description: What a unit can do. Targeting, timing, costs, conditions and the ordered effect list the engine resolves.

arcLance.name: Arc Lance
arcLance.description: One continuous beam into one target. It will not clear a room, but it is the reason a spread-out formation is an inconvenience rather than a shutdown — and it puts charge back in the bank.

arcWelder.name: Arc Welder
arcWelder.description: Burns an enemy for 95 (and may cause a systems fault) or repairs an ally for 70.

basicHeal.name: Basic Heal
basicHeal.description: Restores HP to one ally; recharges after one activation.

battlePlan.name: Battle Plan
battlePlan.description: She looks at what is already coming and decides the order it comes in. Nobody gains a turn and nobody loses one — the squad simply stops acting in the sequence the clock happened to produce.

bladeStrike.name: Blade Strike
bladeStrike.description: Melee strike. Destroying the target refunds this activation's movement once.

blink.name: Blink
blink.description: Teleports the caster to an empty tile.

brace.name: Brace
brace.description: Deploys the bipod: +25 accuracy and attack. Lost the moment this mech moves.

burstFire.name: Burst Fire
burstFire.description: Three separate rounds at up to four tiles. Each round rolls to hit.

carbineBurst.name: Carbine Burst
carbineBurst.description: Two rounds from a weapon chosen for its weight. It will not decide a fight, but it reaches what the frame cannot.

chainDischarge.name: Chain Discharge
chainDischarge.description: Dump the bank into one target and let it find the rest. The arc jumps to whatever is nearest, then to whatever is nearest that, losing a little on every jump. Against a formation standing shoulder to shoulder this is not an attack, it is an event.

challenge.name: Challenge
challenge.description: Names an enemy and takes the guard. While the duel holds, that enemy's decisions are hers to answer.

cleanseAlly.name: Cleanse
cleanseAlly.description: Removes negative statuses from an ally.

cloak.name: Cloak
cloak.description: Conceals this mech: enemies cannot target or see it until it attacks or the field expires.

coolantTransfer.name: Coolant Transfer
coolantTransfer.description: The same clamps, a different rack. Whether the frame on the other end runs on stored thrust or stored charge is a question about them, not about her.

coverAlly.name: Cover Ally
coverAlly.description: Shields a nearby ally for 35 and reinforces its plating for three activations.

defuse.name: Defuse
defuse.description: Somebody has to be able to walk up to the thing and turn it off. It is not glamorous and it takes the whole activation.
defuse.requirementText: Needs an armed device within reach.

delayStrike.name: Delay Strike
delayStrike.description: Weak hit that pushes the target back on the timeline.

demolitionShot.name: Demolition Shot
demolitionShot.description: A short-barrelled launcher. It is what she carries so that having no charges left is inconvenient rather than fatal.

detonate.name: Detonate
detonate.description: Now. Not when they step on it, not when they notice it — now, while three of them are standing in the same place and one of them is reloading.
detonate.requirementText: Needs one of your own charges on the field.

droneWeld.name: Drone Weld
droneWeld.description: Small repair pulse for 55 to a nearby ally.

emberField.name: Ember Field
emberField.description: Sets a tile alight for a few activations.

fieldRepair.name: Field Repair
fieldRepair.description: Repairs an ally for 110 and clears mechanical faults.

forcePush.name: Force Push
forcePush.description: Damages a target and shoves it away.

groundingCycle.name: Grounding Cycle
groundingCycle.description: Spike the bank the fast way. An activation spent doing nothing anyone can see, standing still, in front of people who are shooting.

guardAura.name: Guard Aura
guardAura.description: Test ability: shields every ally around the caster.

guardBreak.name: Guard Break
guardBreak.description: Only worth swinging at somebody already committed to fighting her, which is exactly who she has been arranging to fight.

handCannon.name: Hand Cannon
handCannon.description: Sidearm. Moderate damage at short to medium range with no setup required.

hasteAlly.name: Haste
hasteAlly.description: Raises an ally's Speed for a few activations.

heavyBlow.name: Heavy Blow
heavyBlow.description: Slow melee swing that can end a fragile unit outright.

holdPosition.name: Wait
holdPosition.description: Data-driven equivalent of the wait command.

impactChain.name: Impact Chain
impactChain.description: Acceleration spent on the target instead of the ground: three short impacts in the space of one, the last of which moves them.

ioniseTarget.name: Ionise
ioniseTarget.description: Paint one frame with charged particulate. Nothing happens immediately, which is the point: the arc that comes next reaches a tile further in every direction from whatever was marked.

lineBlast.name: Line Blast
lineBlast.description: Test ability: strikes a line away from the caster.

machStrike.name: Mach Strike
machStrike.description: Accelerate down a lane and put the frame through whatever is at the end of it. What the impact is worth depends entirely on how much runway there was, and the target does not stop where it was standing.
machStrike.requirementText: Needs a legal approach lane; the impact is worth what the runway was.

overwatch.name: Overwatch
overwatch.description: Holds a firing lane: +15 accuracy and +10 evasion while this mech stays still.

placeCharge.name: Place Charge
placeCharge.description: Set a charge and walk away from it. It will sit there doing nothing for as long as it takes, which is the difference between a trap and a decision.

placeMine.name: Place Mine
placeMine.description: Set a pressure plate on a nearby tile. The tile stays walkable, which is the entire point — it has to look like somewhere worth standing.

poisonDart.name: Poison Dart
poisonDart.description: Ranged magic dart that usually leaves Poison behind.

powerTransfer.name: Power Transfer
powerTransfer.description: Hard line, two clamps, and a frame that is about to be able to afford something it could not a moment ago. What comes out of her rack goes into theirs; nothing is created.

precisionShot.name: Precision Shot
precisionShot.description: Braced long-range shot. Requires Brace, consumes it, and needs two activations to cycle. Hits a marked target 15% harder.

quickStrike.name: Quick Strike
quickStrike.description: Cheap melee jab with short recovery.

raiseTestSkeleton.name: Raise Test Skeleton
raiseTestSkeleton.description: Summons a fragile test construct on an empty tile.

reinforce.name: Reinforce
reinforce.description: Reinforces an ally: +25 defense for three activations plus a 40 point shield.

repairDrone.name: Repair Drone
repairDrone.description: Deploys a repair drone on an empty tile for six activations.

ringNova.name: Ring Nova
ringNova.description: Test ability: damages a ring around the target tile.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.description: A short swing with the weight already behind it. Cheap enough to be her ordinary answer, and the same swing she uses out of turn.

scatterShot.name: Scatter Shot
scatterShot.description: Close-range shotgun blast. Reliable damage inside two tiles.

shieldAlly.name: Shield Ally
shieldAlly.description: Grants an ally a temporary damage shield.

spoolDrive.name: Spool Drive
spoolDrive.description: Wind the drives up instead of using them. Buys manoeuvring power at the cost of an activation spent watching nothing.
spoolDrive.requirementText: Requires room in the Burst rack.

stabilize.name: Stabilize
stabilize.description: Clears every negative status on this mech and adds a 25 point shield.

surgeDischarge.name: Surge Discharge
surgeDischarge.description: Everything in the bank at once. Further, more jumps, and it feeds on itself — every frame that drops makes the rest of the chain worse for whoever is left. Afterwards there is nothing in the bank and the frame is still standing where it fired from.

systemRepair.name: System Repair
systemRepair.description: Slower than a patch and worth it. Pulls a damaged system back to operational rather than putting integrity back into the hull.

tacticalRelay.name: Tactical Relay
tacticalRelay.description: She stops fixing frames and starts fixing the plan: bandwidth, a relay mast and two charges of her own turned into something the whole squad can spend.
tacticalRelay.requirementText: Requires room in the squad's Command Points.

tacticalWithdrawal.name: Tactical Withdrawal
tacticalWithdrawal.description: Boosts away from a target by two tiles and raises Speed for two activations.

targetMark.name: Target Mark
targetMark.description: Paints a target: -25 evasion and -15 defense for three activations.

vectorRoute.name: Vector Route
vectorRoute.description: A planned high-speed line through a formation. Hard turns cost stored Burst; the frame can touch something on the way and keep going.
